about_the_game:
Bandit is a Wild West themed action game rooted in classic arcade shoot and beat 'em ups with some added physics in the mix.

Demo Contents

This demo lets you loop through a short section of the game. Increasing in difficulty after every loop and resetting to the start values after the third. The game ends when you run out of lives, which typically won't take very long. 

Bandit is neither easy nor fair. Enemy numbers and placement are partially randomized. This brings an exciting challenge every time you play, but yeah, some times the odds are just not in your favor.

The demo has its own leaderboard. Your score is based on the amount of gold you pick up. Gold is dropped by enemies when they get destroyed. 

Controls

You can play using a keyboard or controller.

  • MOVE around with WASD, ARROW KEYS or STICK.

  • SHOOT by pressing SPACE or any BUTTON.

  • KICK certain objects around by walking into them.

  • RELOAD your gun by not shooting for a short time.

Have fun and we'd love to hear from you if you have any feedback.
AJ & Richard

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.11+ (El Capitan)
  • Processor: Intel or Apple Silicon
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon HD 3870
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 10.11+ (El Capitan)
  • Processor: Intel or Apple Silicon
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GT 640 or better
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Bandit puts you in the boots of a gold-hungry outlaw fighting his way through a western landscape. Dodge bullets, kick chickens, and fight a colorful cast of dangerous characters in your quest for the biggest payout.
